headline: SFG @ ARI matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is SFG 4.35 at ARI 4.15, with a projected total of 8.50. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward ARI: SFG moved -0.47 runs while ARI moved -0.20, changing the projected margin by -0.28 runs. The projected total fell -0.67, which points to a lower-run game script than the earliest saved read. Pitching context: Landen Roupp has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 3.4 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Luis Arraez, Heliot Ramos, Ketel Marte, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Max Kepler, Matt Chapman because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
